title: Harvard (career-office classic)
description: The conservative format university career offices recommend: centred name and contact line, centred bold section headings with a rule, organisation and location on the first line, role and dates in italics below, education first. Serif. Suits any field, including consulting, finance and research.
attribution: Original CSS for this project, following the widely published Harvard Office of Career Services resume guidelines (reverse-chronological, education first, one page). Not affiliated with Harvard University.
